name: Pipeline 4 — Customer Churn & Expansion Intelligence Engine

parameters.content:
## 1. Ingestion
POST /v1/telemetry-ingestion
Raw account telemetry events.

## 2-4. Validation & Enrichment
Inbound schema check → Contract & Usage aggregation → Enriched schema check. Failures routed to DLQ.

## 5-6. Scoring & Routing
Deterministic health matrix (max 100) → Switch gates by tier to the correct sink(s).

## 7. DLQ / Quarantine
Malformed or invalid payloads are dumped to #telemetry-dlq with error context.
